title: Owner leaves disk_dirty true after a clean exit with unchanged content
description: After a read-only owner turn the computer record keeps disk_dirty true and no snapshot is published, so the next start re-hydrates the same snapshot. Decide whether a clean exit with unchanged content should clear the flag; if not, document it. Scenario first.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Triage 2026-10-14 (kept open): Not decided or documented: docs/COMPUTER_SNAPSHOTS.md describes dirty on write but not what a clean exit with unchanged content does. features/owner_observability.feature shows the owner skipping the publish for an unchanged workspace (snapshot_skipped reason unchanged), and features/computer_owner_snapshot.feature clears dirty only after a publish. Still needs the decision (clear the flag on a clean unchanged exit, or document that it stays) and a scenario.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done in PR 561 (merged, commit 633ba0b4): a clean owner exit with unchanged content now clears disk_dirty. The supervisor sends disk_matches_published on the stopped report and the Front Door clears the flag in the same write. Image promoted to development; the owner reported the live test on develop.chattic.us worked very well.

right_now_summary: A clean unchanged owner exit now clears `disk_dirty`, and the live test passed.
